title: Atomic Chat PrismML model compatibility rules
description: Which Bonsai GGUF files need the atomic-prism provider, which also run on stock llama.cpp, and which are legacy layouts no current engine runs. The core reads this to decide the engine for a file before download (by repository and file name) and after download (by sha256 and the GGUF header). `tensor_types` and `metadata_capabilities` turn header evidence into capabilities, so a new Prism packing can be recognised without a client release. The core embeds a baseline copy and keeps working when this file is unreachable.

rules_version.description: Bumped on every semantic change; recorded in model.yml so a stale verdict is recomputed.

tensor_types.description: ggml tensor type id -> capability it requires. `q2_0` (id 42) is resolved further by its bits per weight: 2.25 is the official group-64 layout (q2_0_g64), 2.125 the legacy group-128 layout no current engine runs.

metadata_capabilities.description: GGUF metadata key -> capability its presence requires (prism.hadamard.version -> hadamard).

upstream_capabilities.description: Capabilities the stock llama.cpp providers (llamacpp-upstream, llamacpp) also run. A file needing anything else requires atomic-prism.

revision.description: Hugging Face commit the sizes and hashes were taken from; downloads are pinned to it.

featured.description: Shown first among Bonsai models in Hub.

sampling.description: Model-specific defaults, applied unless the user set their own.

projectors.description: Vision projectors matched to this family. Never substituted across families.

treatment.description: prism_required: only atomic-prism runs it. any: stock llama.cpp runs it too; existing routing is kept. legacy: an old layout no current engine runs; offer `replacement`. excluded: recognised but never offered for download (F16 masters, drafters).

min_prism_build.description: Oldest PrismML build number known to run this file correctly.
